verdict.rationale: The pack documents no built-in feature that analyzes a user's data and surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions. AI Agent flow steps are developer building blocks for constructing such logic, AI generation edits scripts and flows rather than analyzing data, and MCP exposes scripts to external LLM clients. None of these is the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
